# Mizu Omakase

> Mizu Omakase is a Japanese omakase restaurant at Jaya One, Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. 20 seats across two rooms, centred on a curved hinoki counter. The multi-course menu is chosen by our Head Chef according to the season. Three lunch menus from RM139++ and four dinner menus from RM279++ to RM679++.

## Key facts
- Name: Mizu Omakase (Mizu Omakase Sdn. Bhd.)
- Type: Japanese omakase / sushi restaurant (counter dining)
- Address: Jaya One (same row as MyNews), Petaling Jaya 46200, Selangor, Malaysia
- Seats: 20 (two rooms)
- Hours: Thursday–Tuesday, closed Wednesday. Seatings: Lunch 12:00–14:00, Dinner 1 18:00–20:00, Dinner 2 20:30–22:30
- Meal length: approximately 2 hours
- Phone: +60 12-913 0952
- Email: contact.mizuomakase@gmail.com
- Reservations: https://reservation.umai.io/en/widget/mizu-omakase
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mizu.omakase/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61584736661621

## Menus and prices (per guest; ++ = subject to 6% SST and 10% service charge)
Lunch (weekday lunch only, except public holidays & special events):
- Ranchi — RM139++
- Tsuki — RM279++
- Hi — RM479++

Dinner:
- Uteki — RM279++
- Shizuku (cooked menu) — RM279++
- Kiwami (the ultimate nigiri experience) — RM479++
- Ogawa (sea urchin omakase course) — RM679++

Extras: counter add-ons from RM20; premium sake by the bottle RM199–RM1,200; corkage RM200 per bottle (unlimited).
The menu changes with the season; see the menu page for current courses.
